   438	def parse_records(data: bytes, delimiter: int) -> List[List[str]]:
   439	    records: List[List[str]] = []
   440	    record: List[bytes] = []
   441	    field = bytearray()
   442	    record_index = 0
   443	    previous_len: Optional[int] = None
   444	    record_start_line = 1
   445	    record_start_byte = 0
   446	    line = 1
   447	    in_quotes = False
   448	    field_started = False
   449	    record_touched = False
   450	    i = 0
   451	
   452	    def finish_record() -> None:
   453	        nonlocal record, field, field_started, record_touched, previous_len, record_index
   454	        if not record_touched and not field and not record:
   455	            return
   456	        record.append(bytes(field))
   457	        field.clear()
   458	        field_started = False
   459	        if previous_len is not None and len(record) != previous_len:
   460	            raise CsvShapeError(record_index, record_start_line, record_start_byte, len(record), previous_len)
   461	        previous_len = len(record)
   462	        records.append([decode_field(item) for item in record])
   463	        record = []
   464	        record_touched = False
   465	        record_index += 1
   466	
   467	    while i < len(data):
   468	        byte = data[i]
   469	        if in_quotes:
   470	            if byte == 0x22:
   471	                if i + 1 < len(data) and data[i + 1] == 0x22:
   472	                    field.append(0x22)
   473	                    i += 2
   474	                    continue
   475	                in_quotes = False
   476	                i += 1
   477	                continue
   478	            field.append(byte)
   479	            if byte == 0x0A:
   480	                line += 1
   481	            i += 1
   482	            continue
   483	        if byte == delimiter:
   484	            record.append(bytes(field))
   485	            field.clear()
   486	            field_started = False
   487	            record_touched = True
   488	            i += 1
   489	            continue
   490	        if byte == 0x22 and not field_started:
   491	            in_quotes = True
   492	            field_started = True
   493	            record_touched = True
   494	            i += 1
   495	            continue
   496	        if byte in (0x0D, 0x0A):
   497	            finish_record()
   498	            field.clear()
   499	            field_started = False
   500	            record_touched = False
   501	            if byte == 0x0D and i + 1 < len(data) and data[i + 1] == 0x0A:
   502	                i += 2
   503	            else:
   504	                i += 1
   505	            line += 1
   506	            record_start_line = line
   507	            record_start_byte = i
   508	            continue
   509	        field.append(byte)
   510	        field_started = True
   511	        record_touched = True
   512	        i += 1
   513	
   514	    finish_record()
   515	    return records
